mapper.select: select COALESCE(SUM(deleted = 0), 0) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(deleted = 0 AND status = 1), 0) AS enabled, COALESCE(SUM(deleted = 0 AND status = 0), 0) AS disabled, COALESCE(SUM(deleted = 1), 0) AS deleted from user_account

select a.id, a.username, a.email, a.status, a.deleted, a.create_time, a.update_time, b.avatar, b.position, b.company, b.profile, b.extend, b.user_role from user_account a left join user_info b on a.id = b.user_id where a.id = #{userId}
